_doc: Generic CONTACT-ACTION templates (any book): a figure works a WORK piece lying on a SUPPORT with a STRIKER tool held in one hand. Every role is found by AFFORDANCE / prop-class flag, never by name: the striker = a held prop whose library entry (stage_props/props.json) has the striker affordance; the support = a set prop whose prop class (prop_classes.json) has the support flag; the work = the moment's own movable prop (else what rests on the support by the prop state machine), in its class's work_state when it has one; an offhand tool (a prop class with offhand_for: <template>) only when the text names it. Modes from the text: rest (the striker lies somewhere: no action), hold (raised/poised: no impact contact), strike (the striker's face ENDS flush on the work: a contact; the support class's impact_fx at the impact). Examples: a smith's hammer on a blade on an anvil; a cook's cleaver on meat on a chopping block; a mason's mallet on a chisel on stone.
